title: 第十九章 实力斐然袁骅被擒第二十章 横压三百载震古烁今无人敌
content_zh:
孤静深夜。
城西方向传来的声响不难分辨，这是武道高手，纯以肉身碰撞之音。
铁棠展开腿功，八步赶蝉竭力施展，一边往城西赶去，一边有种舒了口气的的感觉。
“这股声势....绝对是易筋以上没错了，想不到吴青那小子隐藏得这么深。
怡红院、东苏马场。
只要抓住吴青，一切应当都会水落石出。“
夜色中，铁棠犹如一头猎豹，在极速奔驰。
他没有看到——
在转瞬即逝的一个路口，有人悄悄打开了窗户，暗中观察。
“筋韧骨坚，血气透体，易筋大成么？”
“怎么会这么快？”
“当日明明已经跌破头颅，气息全失，已然身死，为何又能重新苏醒？
闭气功？龟息术？
不对。
一月之前，他不过区区锻骨小成，不可能习得这些异术。
怪哉，怪哉，事情有些棘手了，需得重新禀报。”
——
待到铁棠赶至城西，这里已经平静下来，他看到了一个出乎意料的人物。
“你如何会出现在此处？”
段景瑞，他竟然在这里，这让铁棠微惊！

随后看到他身上衣衫凌乱，似乎刚刚与人交手。
“段某住在附近，听见捕快搜寻的动静，便起身出来查看，没想到刚好撞见贼人。”
铁棠眉头一皱：“这么巧？”
相比吴青而言，铁棠更关心眼前这位，对方极有可能是想谋害自己的凶手。
身家性命当前，什么案子都要摆一边。
“总捕头似乎对段某有所误会？”段景瑞一脸平静地看着铁棠。
这时刑堂堂主看见气氛不对，赶紧出来打了个圆场。
“咳，总捕头，属下无能，让那吴青贼子逃脱。”
深深看了段景瑞一眼，铁棠转身询问。
“怎么走得？”
“他挟持了袁捕头，我等不好轻易追击，只能眼睁睁看着他离去。”
铁棠一挑眉：“什么？袁骅被他抓走了？”
“正是.....”林堂主整个人腰身弯得都快触地了，今夜着实倒了血霉。
两次被犯人从自己眼皮底下逃脱，还被劫走了人质，偏偏人质还是总捕头的心腹。
这事非但传出去要被人笑话，真正落实下来.....也要有人受到处罚！
只怕自己这个刑堂堂主是做到头了。
这时段景瑞上来给他解围：“总捕头无需怪罪林堂主，依属下之见......那位名为吴青的贼子，修为高深，武学也已入了化境，不是等闲人可以擒拿。”
“刚刚是你与他交手？”
“不错，属下第一个发现此人，见其行踪诡异，便上前尝试想要询问他。
content_en:
Lonely and quiet late at night.
It is not difficult to distinguish the sound coming from the west direction of the city. It is the sound of martial arts masters clashing their bodies.
Tie Tang spread out his leg skills and used his eight steps to catch the cicada with all his strength. He felt relieved as he rushed toward the west of the city.
"This momentum... is definitely above Yi Jin. I didn't expect that boy Wu Qing to hide it so deeply.
Yihongyuan, Dongsu Racecourse.
As long as Wu Qing is caught, everything should fall into place. "
In the night, Tie Tang was like a cheetah, running at top speed.
He didn't see -
At a fleeting intersection, someone quietly opened the window and observed secretly.
"The muscles are strong and the bones are strong, and the blood and energy penetrate the body. Can the muscles and muscles be easily accomplished?"
"How come it's so fast?"
"It was obvious that day that I had fallen head-on, lost all breath, and was already dead. Why could I wake up again?
Kumbhaka? Turtle breath technique?
No.
One month ago, he was only a minor expert in bone forging, so it was impossible for him to learn these strange techniques.
Weird, weird, things are a bit tricky and need to be reported again. "
——
By the time Tie Tang arrived in the west of the city, the place had calmed down and he saw an unexpected figure.
"How did you end up here?"
Duan Jingrui, he is actually here, which makes Tie Tang slightly shocked!
Then I saw that his clothes were messy, as if he had just fought with someone.
"Duan lived nearby and heard the police searching, so he got up and went out to check. Unexpectedly, he happened to bump into the thief."
Tie Tang frowned: "What a coincidence?"
Compared to Wu Qing, Tie Tang was more concerned about the person in front of him, who was most likely the murderer who wanted to kill him.
When one's wealth and life are at stake, any case must be put aside.
"The chief catcher seems to have misunderstood Duan?" Duan Jingrui looked at Tie Tang calmly.
At this time, the head of the execution hall saw that the atmosphere was not right and quickly came out to smooth things over.
"Ahem, the chief arrester, my subordinates are incompetent, let the traitor Wu Qing escape."
After taking a deep look at Duan Jingrui, Tie Tang turned around and asked.
"How can we leave?"
"He held Yuan Baotou hostage. We couldn't easily pursue him, so we could only watch him leave."
Tie Tang raised his eyebrows: "What? Yuan Hua was captured by him?"
"Exactly..." Hall Master Lin's entire waist was bent so much that it almost touched the ground. He was really unlucky tonight.
Twice, prisoners escaped from under his nose, and he was also taken hostage, but the hostage was the chief arrester's henchman.
Not only will this matter be laughed at if word spreads about it, but if it is actually implemented...someone will also be punished!
I'm just afraid that as the leader of the torture hall, I've reached the end.
At this time, Jingrui came up to rescue him: "The chief arrester does not need to blame Hall Master Lin. In the opinion of my subordinates... the thief named Wu Qing has advanced cultivation and martial arts. He is not someone who can be captured by idlers."
"Did you fight him just now?"
"Yes, my subordinates were the first to discover this person. Seeing his strange behavior, they stepped forward and tried to question him.
